rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose way to say that someone actively drives a person or company into bankruptcy.

example.english: That big corporation used low prices to drive the nearby small shops bankrupt.
example.traditional: 嗰間大集團用低價搶客，逼到附近啲小店破產。
